## Extraction ledger — COMPLETE. Closing.

Every FAIL and observation extracted; each defect re-verified live on `origin/main` (`76d74ecb`), zero already-fixed, zero duplicates. Labels `qa-run` + `bug` here are the run record's own; a closed run record stays fully readable.

| Run item | Finding | Card | Lane |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `mcp-stdio-fail-closed` c3 | stdio MCP transport starts but is permanently deaf — oclif's readline `Interface.close()` pauses `process.stdin`, no `resume()` | #7645 | `domain:cli` |
| `mcp-http-surface` (a) | 405 envelope drift — `/mcp/skill` registered `server.get()`-only, method mismatch answered by `unmatchedResponse()`, the `buildApiError` 405 branch is dead | #7649 | `domain:cli` |
| `mcp-http-surface` (b) | stock showcase cannot serve MCP — `hasPluginMatching` substring-matches the outbound `com.objectstack.connector.mcp` client against the `mcp` capability, so `MCPServerPlugin` never loads → 501 | #7652 | `domain:cli` |
| `open-edition-honest-degradation` c3 | anon-deny ordering inverted on `/ai/**` — `handleAIRequest` returns the courtesy/`capabilityUnavailable()` above the `shouldDenyAnonymous` gate | #7653 | `domain:cli` |
| Smaller obs | `GET /meta/skill` lists a skill twice + runtime PUT `{active:true}` never reaches the prompt bridge (`listSkills` reads `metadataService.list` vs HTTP `getMetaItems` override-merge) | #7654 | `domain:metadata` |
| Smaller obs | `?preview=draft` self-inflicts an invalid diagnostic — `_draft:true` stamped then validated with that key | #7656 | `domain:metadata` |

The 4 PASS items produced no cards.

**Two things worth carrying forward:**
- Three of the four FAILs (#7645/#7649/#7652) are **"green unit pins, dead real surface"** — 17/17 stdio pins green while every CLI stdio transport is deaf; the 405 domain branch pinned but unreachable on the hono adapter; the capability resolved by substring while the server never loads. Each needs an **end-to-end CLI-surface assertion**, not another unit pin — same shape as the security card #7626's acceptance bar.
- #7652's root cause — a **substring match between a provider and a consumer plugin name** — is a general hazard, not a one-off; flagged in the card for whoever fixes it.

Provenance: maintainer instruction 2026-08-11 (chat, verbatim) 「收到一组新的 qa …」 + the standing rule that every QA problem becomes an issue; run records close at extraction, same exit as #7514/#7463.
